title.narrative: DtZ- Stepping Up the Fight Against Sexual Exploitation of Children (Thailand)

description.narrative: The SUFASEC programme is designed to combat SEC by working towards the following long-term impact: “Children in all of their diversity are better protected from sexual exploitation.” The long-term impact will be reached through three interlinking objectives that address different dimensions (social norms, assets/environments, and laws/policies/systems). The different stakeholder groups involved in the SUFASEC programme include: Children and youth in all their diversity, Caregivers and Communities, CSOs and CBOs, Local and national governments, Private Secto, International donors, Intergovernmental bodies, INGOs, Multilateral entities, Dutch Stakeholders, Media & Journalists
